title: Complement characterization of the polynomial hierarchy
statement: For every integer $i\ge 0$ and every binary language $L$, the complement of $L$ belongs to the $i$th universal level of the polynomial hierarchy if and only if $L$ belongs to the $i$th existential level: $L^{c}\in\Pi_i^P$ if and only if $L\in\Sigma_i^P$.
